notes.title: Update 0.3.0 - Party members
notes.notes:
This update introduces an optional playstyle where you control multiple characters at once:
[list]
[*]You can switch between your party members and each one has separate stats, inventory, and spells
[*]You can recruit party members in the lobby by using the Soulforge
[*]You can encounter a "Fellow" in the dungeon who will join you
[/list]

Other changes and fixes:
[list]
[*]Outline shader tweaks
[*]Changed player height
[*]Some UI tweaks
[*]Added lava particles
[*]Fixed boss portraits not rendering correctly in the lobby
[*]Fixed an issue with incorrect controller detection when SteamInput is enabled
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.2.1 - UI adjustments
notes.notes:
Changes:
[list]
[*]Changed the crafting window layout
[*]Changed stats readout in the character tab
[*]New minimap colors
[*]Labels on the left side of the screen are no longer shown if the inventory is closed
[*]Changed seen objects list colors on the right side of the screen and added arrows
[*]Added a button to sort inventory items
[*]Added a tip for when you need to use a shovel or pickaxe on an object
[*]The new run screen now shows "Undiscovered enemy" for enemies the player has never encountered before
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.1.2 - Classes
notes.notes:
This update adds classes to the game. 4 classes are available: Rogue, Necromancer, Imposter, and Bogwalker.

Rogue: A nimble and agile fighter focused on mobility and positioning.
Necromancer: A dark magic practitioner who commands undead forces.
Imposter: A master of deception and stealth who can manipulate enemies and escape danger.
Bogwalker: A nature-bound clumsy warrior who harnesses poison and plant magic but fears fire.

notes.title: Update 0.1.1 - Daily challenges
notes.notes:
Changes:
[list]
[*]Added daily challenges with leaderboards: Every day, players around the world get to play the same dungeon seed, but you only get one chance per day.
[*]Nerfed archer
[*]Improved lobby shopkeeper cage visibility
[*]Misc tuning and typo fixes
[/list]
